title: Partial fine-tuning by freezing attention weights

cues.en: You already know about the concept of tide weights, which is where two weights matrices are linked together.
cues.zh: 你已經知道權重綁定的概念，也就是把兩個權重矩陣連結在一起。

cues.en: If you studied deep learning before, then you're probably also familiar with the concept of freezing weights during fine tuning or during transfer learning.
cues.zh: 如果之前學過深度學習，你可能也熟悉在微調或遷移學習時凍結權重的做法。

cues.en: This is commonly done in CNN architectures for computational vision.
cues.zh: 這在電腦視覺的 CNN 架構中很常見。

cues.en: You can also freeze weights in LMS, which has a number of potential benefits that I will discuss towards the end of this video.
cues.zh: LLM 也能凍結權重，這有幾項潛在好處，我會在影片後段討論。

cues.en: But first, I will remind you what it means to freeze a weights matrix, and then I'll have a code demo.
cues.zh: 先來複習凍結權重矩陣的意思，接著示範程式。

cues.en: Or actually I'll show you how to do this in PyTorch.
cues.zh: 也就是示範如何在 PyTorch 中操作。

cues.en: The upshot of this video is that it's actually really easy to freeze weights in terms of the coding
cues.zh: 這支影片的重點是，就程式實作而言，凍結權重其實很簡單，

cues.en: implementation, but it can be overwhelming to think about all of the possibilities for sets of weights that could be frozen in fine tuning.
cues.zh: 但微調時可以凍結的權重組合太多，思考起來可能令人眼花撩亂。

cues.en: So what does frozen weights mean?
cues.zh: 那麼，凍結權重是什麼意思？

cues.en: It has nothing to do with weightlifting in Norway in the winter outside.
cues.zh: 這跟冬天在挪威戶外舉重完全無關。

cues.en: Instead, freezing weights means that you prevent the parameters from being modified during back propagation.
cues.zh: 凍結權重是指不讓參數在反向傳播期間被修改。

cues.en: So normally when you run backprop, the error signal propagates back through every weight in the model.
cues.zh: 一般執行反向傳播時，誤差信號會往回經過模型中的每個權重。

cues.en: However, if a weight is frozen, then backprop will skip over that parameter and it will not be adjusted.
cues.zh: 但如果某個權重被凍結，反向傳播就會略過該參數，不調整它。

cues.en: This is certainly not something you want to do during pre-training, but it is a common technique in fine tuning, transfer learning and instruction tuning.
cues.zh: 預訓練時當然不會想這麼做，但在微調、遷移學習和指令微調時，這是常見技巧。

cues.en: It is quite common to freeze weights in computer vision models, especially if you are fine tuning on a small data set.
cues.zh: 電腦視覺模型很常凍結權重，尤其是在小型資料集上微調時。

cues.en: And why would you want to do this?
cues.zh: 為什麼要這麼做？

cues.en: There are several reasons why freezing weights is beneficial.
cues.zh: 凍結權重有好幾項好處。

cues.en: I will discuss these in more detail after the code demo, but the basic idea is that it decreases computation
cues.zh: 程式示範後我會詳細討論，基本概念是減少計算時間，

cues.en: time and requires fewer resources to train large models, and it also makes the adjustments a little more targeted and a little bit more subtle.
cues.zh: 降低訓練大型模型所需的資源，也讓調整更有針對性、更細微。

cues.en: In PyTorch, freezing is very simple to toggle.
cues.zh: 在 PyTorch 中，開關凍結狀態非常簡單。

cues.en: There is a parameter in every PyTorch tensor called requiresgrad, and all of the tensors that are attached
cues.zh: 每個 PyTorch 張量都有一個叫 requires_grad 的屬性，而連結到

cues.en: to a particular model have Requiresgrad equals true, and you can simply set this parameter to false, and that freezes that tensor.
cues.zh: 特定模型的所有張量，其 requires_grad 都是 True。把它設成 False，就能凍結該張量。

cues.en: So it freezes all of the parameters in that matrix.
cues.zh: 也就是凍結那個矩陣中的所有參數。

cues.en: So why would you want to freeze any weights at all?

cues.en: There are several reasons.
cues.zh: 有幾個原因。

cues.en: One is that by training only some of the parameters in the model, you reduce the risk of overfitting.
cues.zh: 第一，只訓練模型中的部分參數，可以降低過度擬合的風險。

cues.en: And that is especially true if you want to prevent the model from developing too many training sets.
cues.zh: 尤其當你希望避免模型形成太多訓練集

cues.en: Training set specific idiosyncrasies.
cues.zh: 特有的細節時，更是如此。

cues.en: In fact, it is these kinds of idiosyncrasies that are literally exactly what we've been training models to generate.

cues.en: helps the model adapt better, because you have the same amount of data and fewer parameters to be modified.
cues.zh: 能幫助模型更好地適應，因為資料量相同，需要修改的參數卻更少。

cues.en: An example of this could be if you are fine tuning a model on technical documentation inside a company.

cues.zh: 但相較於預訓練資料，這個資料集非常非常小。

cues.en: So only training parts of the model might be beneficial.
cues.zh: 因此，只訓練部分模型可能有幫助。

cues.en: Another benefit is just very practical.
cues.zh: 另一項好處很實際。

cues.en: In this course, we are mostly working with relatively small llms that have maybe a few hundred million
cues.zh: 這門課主要使用相對較小的 LLM，可能有幾億個

cues.en: parameters, but the models that are used in practice have billions or tens of billions of parameters.
cues.zh: 參數，但實際應用的模型有幾十億，甚至幾百億個參數。

cues.en: And so fine tuning those kinds of models costs a lot of time and money, not to mention the computational resources.
cues.zh: 微調這些模型要花很多時間與金錢，更不用說運算資源。

cues.en: So therefore people will freeze large sections of the model just so that it's more feasible to train on limited resources.
cues.zh: 因此，大家會凍結模型的大部分，讓有限資源下的訓練更可行。

cues.en: Finally, you can also do targeted freezing.
cues.zh: 最後，也能做有針對性的凍結。

cues.en: So for example, earlier transformer blocks tend to learn more low level syntax and semantics.
cues.zh: 例如，較前面的 Transformer 區塊通常學習較低階的句法與語意。

cues.zh: 也就是基本語言結構；較後面的層通常學習較高階的語境與抽象模式。

cues.en: while allowing the training to focus more on higher level features.

cues.zh: 現在討論該凍結模型的哪些部分，以及何時凍結。

cues.en: Here you have an explosion of possibilities for which specific layers in the model you want to freeze.
cues.zh: 究竟要凍結哪些特定層，可選擇的組合非常多。

cues.en: For example, if you freeze all the MLP layers and allow the attention layers to continue to be adjusted,
cues.zh: 例如，凍結所有 MLP 層，讓注意力層繼續調整，

cues.en: that can preferentially modify how the tokens over time are indicated.
cues.zh: 就能優先修改不同時間位置的詞元之間如何互相指示。

cues.en: Now, I've kind of discussed this point earlier, which is basically that freezing the earlier transformer
cues.zh: 這點先前已經提過：凍結較前面的 Transformer

cues.en: blocks allows the training to focus more on high level text and context features, while preserving the semantic and syntactic knowledge.
cues.zh: 區塊，可以保留語意與句法知識，讓訓練專注於較高階的文本與語境特徵。

cues.en: Uh, this point here is that you can also freeze a layer at the beginning of fine tuning and then unfreeze it after, for example, the first hundred training samples.
cues.zh: 也可以在微調一開始先凍結某一層，等前一百筆訓練樣本跑完後再解凍。

cues.en: Or maybe you monitor the losses during fine tuning and unfreeze some layers when the loss drops below some threshold that you pick.
cues.zh: 或是在微調時監測損失，降到你選定的門檻以下時，解凍某些層。

cues.en: And finally, in the field of mechanistic interpretability.
cues.zh: 最後，在機制可解釋性領域，

cues.en: People use targeted freezing to test hypotheses about what different parts of the model can learn.
cues.zh: 研究者會用有針對性的凍結，檢驗模型不同部分能學到什麼的假說。

cues.en: In other words, freezing is also used for research purposes, not only for practical application purposes.
cues.zh: 換句話說，凍結也用於研究，不只是實務應用。

cues.en: So freezing during fine tuning is both extremely easy and extremely hard.
cues.zh: 所以，微調時凍結權重，既極其簡單，也極其困難。

cues.en: It's extremely easy because it's basically just one piece of code to run.
cues.zh: 簡單是因為，基本上只要執行一小段程式。

cues.en: But it's extremely hard because there are so many possibilities for what and when to freeze.
cues.zh: 困難則在於，凍結什麼、何時凍結，有太多可能。

cues.en: And although there are some guidelines about which layers to freeze, the reality is that in practice,
cues.zh: 雖然有一些選擇凍結層的指引，但實際上，

cues.en: freezing involves a lot of exploration and experimentation and can get quite time consuming.
cues.zh: 凍結往往需要大量探索與實驗，也可能相當耗時。

cues.en: You will get a taste of this in the code challenge in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片的程式挑戰，就會讓你體驗這件事。
